query:
INSERT INTO dealers (userId, name, description, address, city, postcode, phone, email, whatsappNumber, isVerified, subscriptionStatus, subscriptionExpiresAt, createdAt, updatedAt)
SELECT id, 'Test Motors Ltd', 'Test dealer for marketplace testing', '123 Test Street', 'London', 'SW1A 1AA', '07700900000', 'testdealer@eveevo.com', '447700900000', 1, 'active', DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 YEAR), NOW(), NOW()
FROM users WHERE openId = 'test-dealer-001'
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE subscriptionStatus = 'active', subscriptionExpiresAt = DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 YEAR);
